changed_records: source (PER-003 Rev A, DS-101 Rev A, DS-104 Rev B)
proposal: Reduce water injection and size the SCR for the higher GT-outlet NOx on LDO (ER-03.11 already requires an SCR designed for LDO).
question: The EPC HMB of PER-003 case SRC-LDO-100 gives 558.8 MW net against PG-15 (>= 560 MW), margin -0.21 %. In addition the case implies a compressor air flow of 701 kg/s on LDO against 776 kg/s on gas at the same ambient with the IGV fully open, which is not plausible: with the gas-operation air flow the stated LDO rating and water/fuel ratio 1.02 give an exhaust temperature of about 553 degC and about 543 MW / 6,300 kJ/kWh net, missing PG-15 and PG-16. Please re-rate the LDO case with the real air flow and propose how the LDO guarantees are met.
response: Agreed - the Rev 0 LDO case back-calculated the air flow. PER-003 Rev A: gas-operation air flow (776.0 kg/s), LDO rating 400.5 MW / 8,640 kJ/kWh, water/fuel 0.60 (13.4 kg/s) with GT-outlet NOx <= 150 mg/Nm3 and the IEC SCR sized for 67 % removal on LDO (DS-104 Rev B: catalyst +35 %, ammonia 480 kg/h on LDO). Exhaust 811.9 kg/s at 592.7 degC; ST 178.37 MW; about 567 MW / 6,100 kJ/kWh net with the EPC auxiliaries. New IEC guarantees IG-09/IG-10 on LDO.
subject: LDO case: net output below PG-15 and implausible air flow
